summary: Complete source bank q-72858 is missing and cannot replay or generate. Tested available content and the exact five-item batch passed math, native grading, rendering and packaging; no tested universal batch shortcut was found.

source_analysis.skill: Identify which of five elementary row operations changes a specified entry of a 3 by 3 integer coefficient matrix to zero.
reasoning_steps: Read target row and column from a_ij.
Evaluate candidate row operations, rejecting operations that leave a nonzero target unchanged or do not cancel it.
Select the unique listed successful operation; worked solution applies that operation to the whole matrix.
invariants: One elementary row operation; no multi-step elimination or solving a system.
Nonzero scaling and distinct rows for row addition.
Exactly one valid listed choice achieves the stated target.
Prompt, correct bank entry, full-row arithmetic and explanation agree.
permitted_variations: All target coordinates and donor/recipient assignments may vary if prompt and dependencies follow.
Signed small integer entries, integer and simple fractional cancellation factors, matrix letter and option order may vary.
The successful listed donor and factor must be determined by entries rather than fixed labels or template signatures.
Distinct candidate row-addition options can exchange correctness when the relevant matrix entry changes while the rest stays fixed.
Non-target columns and matrix name are irrelevant to the selected operation and may change without changing the response.

source_replay.details: 10/11 supplied question banks replay with all choices and independently correct keys/results. Complete q-72858 is absent from packaged source and raises Unknown source profile. Canonical row arithmetic verified without inventing its missing bank. q-130301 correction and q-20392 inferred completion are supported.

math.details: Exact independent Fraction evaluation verifies unique successful choice and full result matrix for 98 independent samples, all 5 runner items, 5 counterfactuals, and 10 available source replays. Missing profile is a source-coverage failure, not a claim of correct generation.

variety.details: 34 winner assignments across 9 sampled banks and all 9 target coordinates observed; all survive delivery. Nevertheless complete supplied q-72858 is unavailable, and q-20392 is replay-only. Required source-bank coverage is incomplete.

scope.details: Represented variations preserve 3x3 matrices, five radio choices, a zero target and one elementary operation. Correct swaps are supported by the lesson and target-column-dependent rule; integer/simple fractional additions preserve the taught skill.

grading.details: Actual native grade_field: 21 correct selections accepted, 84 independent distractors rejected, zero unresolved. Includes both relevant/irrelevant counterfactual outcomes and corrected source replays. Free-entry equivalence is inapplicable to this radio contract.

rendering.details: Actual unmodified UI renderer passed all 12 cases; screenshots inspected for matrices, fractions, target indices, answer controls and worked solutions, including controlled pairs and all 5 runner items.

packaging.details: Exact installed versions match manifest (Python 3.13.5, sympy 1.14.0, mpmath 1.3.0). Deterministic question replay, repeated batch calls, relocated CLI JSON output and invalid-instance rejection verified. No assets/external-output handling needed; package hashes unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Controlled relevant and irrelevant pairs, conditional probes for every sampled bank, exact-batch probes and post-filter coverage were examined. No tested incidental cue solves the full delivered batch; positive hard-weight selection preserves eligible fresh records. Overall coverage fails because the complete q-72858 bank is missing. Live policy/history and future inventory are not supplied; selection conclusions are conditional on the captured basis and stated rule.

findings.description: The package freezes source_data.json at basis 4571 and omits fully supplied q-72858 (372c1499-bf5a-558e-ad8a-af28e6ae7898) from basis 5360. Its original matrix [[2,1,3],[6,4,3],[1,2,3]], target a23=0, and five-option bank have the unique correct operation R2:=R2-R1, yielding second row [4,3,0]. Both replay and normal generation reject the entire profile as unknown. This is an omitted source family, not an arithmetic defect in the five runner records.
